description_en: Query log backup files for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 MongoDB 版实例的日志备份文件
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-binlog-files --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id dds-wz9ca592fc637a54 --node-id d-uf696817a1b5d9f4 --start-time 2021-03-23T06:24:21.425Z --end-time 2023-04-17T05:50:28.914Z --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --src-region ap-southeast-1 --dest-region cn-beijing --binlog-id example-string --resource-group-id rg-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBinlogFiles
